factories.name: Alien Power
factories.notes:
Three unfueled Alien Power Augmenters: 500 MW each plus a +10% grid boost per augmenter. Each costs 10 Somersloops to construct.

Phase 5 Intermediates makes 4/min Alien Power Matrixes spare — a fueled augmenter needs 5/min, so bump that clock if you want to toggle a group to Supply Matrixes for +30%.

factories.name: Geothermal Power
factories.notes: Geothermal Generators are fuel-less — one producer per geyser purity (Impure 100 MW, Normal 200 MW, Pure 400 MW average per generator), each oscillating between 0.5x and 1.5x of the average.
